title: Indonesia invades East Timor
summary: Indonesian forces invaded East Timor on 7 December 1975, nine days after FRETILIN had declared independence and with the Portuguese administration withdrawn to Ataúro. The territories layer draws East Timor as a Portuguese colony until 16 July 1976, the date CShapes gives for its annexation by Indonesia, so the map and this record answer different questions — who held the ground, and who is recorded as administering it.
